cases.name: an actor starts in its machine's initial state
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > initial state > .getSnapshot returns the initial state (the value after start; the format reads no snapshot of an actor not yet started)

cases.name: an actor spawned by the initial state's entry is spawned once, when the actor starts
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > initial state > initially spawned actors should not be spawned when reading initial state (the one spawn after start; the format has no step before start, and a spawnChild with an id stands for the spawn the test assigns to the context)

cases.name: a delayed raise in the initial entry fires once its delay has passed
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > send with delay > can send an event after a delay (on the simulated clock from start; the wait before start is not ported, as the format starts first)

cases.name: a delayed raise entered by a transition finishes the machine only after its delay
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > send with delay > can send an event after a delay (expression) (the delay as the 150 ms its expression computes here, a named delay; a delay computed from the context and the event is not ported)

cases.name: a delayed raise armed by ACTIVATE leaves the machine pending at 101 ms and finishes it at 151 ms
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > send with delay > can send an event after a delay (expression using _event) (the timing only, with the delay as the 150 ms its expression computes here, a named delay, which makes the case the same as the port of "can send an event after a delay (expression)"; the delay function's assertEvent(event, 'ACTIVATE'), its check that it is given the event that entered pending, is not ported, as a delay computed from the context and the event is not)

cases.name: named after delays and a delayed raise walk the machine to its final state
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > send with delay > can send an event after a delay (delayed transitions) (each named delay as the value its function computes here, delayA 100, someDelay 150, delayD 300; a delay computed from the context and the event is not ported)

cases.name: a cancelled delayed raise never fires
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > can cancel a delayed event

cases.name: an entry cancels its own delayed raise and the other one fires
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > can cancel a delayed event using expression to resolve send id (the id given fixed, on the simulated clock; a cancel whose id is computed by a function is not ported)

cases.name: a stopped actor processes no further event
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > should not update when stopped (the warning for the event sent to a stopped actor is not ported)

cases.name: each action sees the event of its own microstep, the raised one after the external one
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > should receive correct event (log action) (the log action replaced by push_event into the context; the logger is not ported)

cases.name: a raised event with a payload passes its guard and finishes the machine
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > send() event expressions > should resolve send event expressions (the event given fixed as the one its expression computes here; an event computed from the context is not ported)

cases.name: a child given its context by input sends its parent an event that finishes it
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > sendParent() event expressions > should resolve sendParent event expressions (the event given fixed as the one its expression computes from the child's context here; an event computed from the context is not ported)

cases.name: events sent to a root created and not started wait for its start
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > should defer events sent to an uninitialized service

cases.name: a send to a root created and not started does not fail
cases.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > should not throw an error if an event is sent to an uninitialized interpreter (not throwing is the event being accepted: a start step, which the test does not take, shows the root processing SOME_EVENT after xstate.init)

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > initial state > does not execute actions from a restored state
excluded.reason: restores a persisted snapshot (getPersistedSnapshot, then createActor with snapshot), which is out of scope

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > initial state > should not execute actions that are not part of the actual persisted state
excluded.reason: restores a persisted snapshot (getPersistedSnapshot, then createActor with snapshot), which is out of scope

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > subscribing > should not notify subscribers of the current state upon subscription (subscribe)
excluded.reason: asserts that subscribe, called on a started actor, does not call its observer with the current snapshot; no step subscribes an observer, and the record holds what each actor processed, through the inspection API, not an observer's calls. It would need a subscribe step and a record of what the observer received

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > activities (deprecated) > should start activities
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > activities (deprecated) > should stop activities
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > activities (deprecated) > should stop activities upon stopping the service
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > activities (deprecated) > should restart activities from a compound state
excluded.reason: fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer); the test also restores a persisted snapshot (getPersistedSnapshot, then createActor with snapshot), which is out of scope

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > should throw an error if initial state sent to interpreter is invalid
excluded.reason: XState creates the actor and leaves its snapshot in error, 'Initial state node "create" not found'; xstate refuses a config whose initial names no state when the machine is created (doc: #differences-refused), so there is no actor to compare

excluded.test: interpreter.test.ts > interpreter > should be able to log (log action)
excluded.reason: the logger is out of scope: a log action's message is not recorded, and the value logged here is the whole context, which no vocabulary action can push into the context
